title: Optional hybrid fields in a room's site.json (and one entry of topics/domains.json)
description: All optional. A site.json without `mode` is a room, exactly as today. Config only: nothing in this PR writes these fields into any room repo or serves a redirect.

mode.description: room = its own site (today's default); doorway = redirects to the hub topic; parked = no room, no redirect (holding page or registrar parking)

topic.description: slug in topics/seed_wave1.json; required for doorway

brand.description: which brand file names the hub: default = brand/brand.json (never a literal brand name)

status.description: computed by tools/topic_status.py doorway_status(): 302 until the topic has been active 60 days, then 301
